data.narrative:
Newcleo is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Stefano Buono, Luciano Cinotti, and Elisabeth Rizzotti. The company has raised $755M+ to date. The broader nuclear energy sector includes 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers, including Valar Atomics, Helion, Oklo, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which is applicable given Newcleo's defined Series B stage and capital raised. Using $755M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B to next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $1.4B. A peer-median approach was not viable; while 6 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier) returned fewer than three datapoints, making sector-wide median comparison unreliable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.2B (low) to $1.6B (high), with a median point of $1.4B. This range reflects the single quantifiable method available. Key uncertainties include the absence of tightly comparable late-stage private nuclear energy transactions and the limited publicly traded comparable universe in this sector. Any refinement would require additional market data on recent Series B or Series C nuclear energy closings or tighter definition of technology-stage alignment within the peer set.
